content.text:
All three renders are clean. Final results:

| File | Size | Scale | Photo band |
|---|---|---|---|
| portrait.png | 1080×1350 | 1.0 (master) | 1080×590, cover-cropped |
| wide.png | 1200×1000 | 0.85 | 1200×412 |
| sky.png | 300×600 | 0.28 | 300×300 |

**How it works:** one `template.html` with a single `--s` scale token; every type size, padding, gap, icon dimension and rule weight is `calc(Npx * var(--s))`, so all three sizes are exactly the same design at 1×, 0.85× and 0.28×. The three HTML files are generated from it by substituting the scale.

**Layout guarantees:**
- Bands (photo, red CTA) are body-level flex children at 100% width with no horizontal padding, so they stay edge-to-edge at every size; only text blocks get the scaled `.pad` inset.
- Photo uses `object-fit: cover` in a fixed-width band, so it crops (no distortion) at all three aspect ratios; the band is `flex: 1` with a `min-height` and a 50vh cap, so it absorbs leftover vertical space instead of leaving an awkward gap, and `justify-content: space-between` evenly distributes any residual slack (sky: 17.4px between every section — verified equal).
- Candidate columns are `flex: 1 1 0` with `min-width: 0` and a scaled gap, so the three are mathematically equal-width and evenly spaced at every size; names are `nowrap` and still fit inside the 95px-wide sky columns.

**Verification:** I ran a DOM audit (`audit.mjs`) at each viewport checking `scrollWidth/Height` vs viewport, per-element overflow, and out-of-bounds bounding boxes. No document overflow (exactly 1080×1350, 1200×1000, 300×600), nothing clipped, nothing out of frame; the only flags were 1px `scrollHeight` line-box rounding on non-clipping elements, which I removed by relaxing the CTA line-height to 1.12, then re-rendered and visually inspected all three PNGs.
